//: Sandbox societal priorities. No ethnicity predetermines them. Weights mix; they are not instantly selectable bonuses. Pressures and modifiers support JSON/YAML overlays.

institutional_continuity.name: Institutional continuity
institutional_continuity.description: Predictable institutions and established procedures, sometimes at the expense of rapid change.

national_security.name: National security
national_security.description: Collective protection takes priority over investment and unrestricted civic life.

social_solidarity.name: Social solidarity
social_solidarity.description: Social protection and reducing regional grievances become central public expectations.

commercial_openness.name: Commercial openness
commercial_openness.description: Exchange and enterprise prosper in peace; dependence on wider markets has a financing cost.

civic_pluralism.name: Civic pluralism
civic_pluralism.description: A plural public sphere supports research and peaceful organising, including inconvenient regional voices.

strategic_autonomy.name: Strategic autonomy
strategic_autonomy.description: Self-reliance favours domestic capacity while limiting access to international exchange.

fiscal_rehabilitation.name: Fiscal rehabilitation
fiscal_rehabilitation.description: Restoring payment credibility becomes a social priority after sustained financial distress.

postwar_renewal.name: Postwar renewal
postwar_renewal.description: War exhaustion makes reconstruction and reconciliation more important than another escalation.
